mode.description: The single public skill mode selected from the request. Use select only for graph-versus-loop decisions or scope/artifact classification; an explicit request to design a new workflow uses design.

artifact.description: The public artifact returned by that mode.

decision.description: Use graph for a new design, existing_graph for compile/audit/diagnose/optimize, candidate_graph only for persistent evolution of an existing graph, out_of_scope for excluded GraphRAG or graph-database work, and no_graph_artifact when supplied material is only a diagram, trace, ordinary program, or informal conversation without all four graph-artifact conditions.
